Describes the faith portrayed by Daniel, Mary the mother of Jesus. | The learner
Reads, spells and writes structures and sentences related to people of great faith in the Bible. | Daniel
Daniel was a man who loved God very much. He was careful in the way he related with others. Daniel had faith in God and was reliable.
It was Daniel’s faith in God that saved him from the lions. It was again Daniels’ faith in God that made him obey the order to worship the king.
Mary-the mother of Jesus. Mary the mother of Jesus is one of the women with great faith in God.
One day, an angel of the lord visited Mary. The angel came shortly after Mary had just accepted to be married to a man called Joseph.
Although Mary was still a virgin and was about toget married to Joseph, she did not refuse to become pregnant by the power of God. She accepted the role God had given her.
She did not mind about what Joseph and other people would say about her.
